name: 01-system-architecture
title: 01 | Production authority, failure domains and recovery dependencies
description: Controlled local-source topology. PostgreSQL is authoritative; backup and isolated recovery facilities are bank-provisioned. Optional stores are not enabled by this plan.

name: 02-consistency-groups
title: 02 | One recovery cohort, multiple distinct authorities
description: Every cohort binds SQL, file versions, Redis roles, source identities, release/configuration and separately held recovery keys. A per-store checksum is not cross-store consistency.

name: 03-backup-dataflow
title: 03 | End-to-end backup: capture is not completion
description: Backup completion requires remote durable copy, independent integrity/custody evidence and a witnessed isolated restore. Encryption alone does not provide immutability or site recovery.

name: 04-recovery-dataflow
title: 04 | End-to-end disaster recovery and controlled cutover
description: Recovery begins with authority and fencing, not restoring a database into an active service. Each gate can stop cutover; keys and platform dependencies must be available before controlled service starts.

name: 05-execution-reconciliation
title: 05 | Restored SQL execution authority and UNKNOWN handling
description: Redis redelivery is only a hint. Only eligible QUEUED work can claim. UNKNOWN retains reservations until authorized exact-owner evidence-backed reconciliation; no status reset or invented completion.

name: 06-key-and-ransomware-boundaries
title: 06 | Recovery trust, keys and ransomware isolation
description: Target bank-owned control plane. Backup access, delete rights, keys and restore authority must not all belong to the compromised production identity. This is a plan, not provisioned infrastructure.

name: 07-failback-dataflow
title: 07 | Failback without discarding recovery-site writes
description: Failback is another controlled migration. The old site must not resume from its stale disk or old backup after new recovery-side writes have been accepted.

name: 08-drill-and-acceptance
title: 08 | Drill evidence, measured objectives and recovery acceptance
description: Drills must be pre-authorized, isolated and independently reviewed. Missing or failed mandatory evidence blocks the stated recovery claim; a planning diagram does not establish an SLA.
